mapper.select: SELECT EDUCATION_CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, SORT_ORDER, HIDDEN_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM EDUCATION_COURSE_CATEGORY ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, EDUCATION_CATEGORY_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDUCATION_COURSE_CATEGORY ( CATEGORY_NAME, SORT_ORDER, HIDDEN_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{hiddenYn}, #{useYn}, NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE EDUCATION_COURSE_CATEGORY
CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName},
SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder},
HIDDEN_YN = #{hiddenYn},
USE_YN = #{useYn},
UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy},
UPDATED_AT = NOW()
WHERE EDUCATION_CATEGORY_ID = #{educationCategoryId}
